tasks.short: Receive and screen telephone calls and visitors.

steps.what: Receive the caller or visitor and establish the actual purpose and urgency of contact
inputs: actual caller or visitor and stated reason
outputs: actual contact request and observed urgency

steps.what: Find the appropriate internal contact and current availability using the native telephone directory
inputs: actual contact request and observed urgency
existing current internal directory and availability

steps.what: Write and approve the final contact request, minimum necessary details and chosen internal destination
inputs: actual contact request and observed urgency
checked routing option
outputs: approved final screened contact request and internal destination

steps.what: Transfer the approved screened call or visitor request to the chosen internal destination
inputs: approved final screened contact request and internal destination

steps.what: Save the approved final screened contact request
inputs: approved final screened contact request and internal destination
outputs: saved screened request without presumed resolution

tasks.design: Configure the native {TELEPHONY} directory/availability view. OTHER denotes the existing {CLINICAL_CONTACT_RECORD}. Keep reception, screening and urgency judgement with the person, with a separate written request approval before routing. Save the actual screened request separately; same-system save earns no benefit. No clinical triage bot is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct currently available contact may require repeated directory searches.
tasks.enabler_now: Native telephone directory and availability views can reduce lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding a distressed caller or visitor and recognising when clinical staff must take over.
tasks.human_edge: The receptionist notices context and handles uncertainty respectfully.
tasks.altitude: Human contact screening with faster internal directory retrieval.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native telephony directories can show existing internal contact and availability information.

assumptions: All shares are provisional; verify residual contact lookup after current telephone functions. Existing automatic routing earns no benefit.

Staff/directory owners supply existing department, extension and availability in normal work. s2 retains freshness checks; missing entries require manual lookup. s3 retains full actual capture of request_reason, minimum_contact_detail and chosen_destination after reception.

s4 routes only the approved screened request; urgent clinical issues go to actual clinical staff under existing procedures. s5 saves that request and never labels it resolved. Same-system save and live routing remain full.
research_questions: What contact lookup remains manual after current telephony directory functions?

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final screened request and internal destination
s3 final screened request for record retention

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only directory lookup changes: 10 times 50% = 5 hours less 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. Low halves lookup benefit: 2.5 minus 0.5 = 2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Receive patients, schedule appointments and maintain patient records.

steps.what: Receive the patient and establish their actual appointment request and circumstances
inputs: actual patient and request

steps.what: Verify patient identity and capture actual contact, request and authorised appointment requirements
inputs: actual patient appointment request
actual patient identifiers and existing authorised appointment requirements

steps.what: Find eligible actual appointment slots using native duration, service and clinician availability filters
inputs: checked patient appointment fields
existing actual available appointment slots and service rules

steps.what: Populate the appointment draft from checked patient fields and the selected actual slot
inputs: checked patient appointment fields
checked eligible appointment options
actual patient-selected slot

steps.what: Confirm the patients chosen slot and approve the complete final appointment and record changes
inputs: complete candidate patient appointment
actual patient confirmation
outputs: approved final appointment and patient record changes

steps.what: Commit the approved final appointment and patient record changes
inputs: approved final appointment and patient record changes
outputs: actual saved appointment and patient record version

steps.what: Verify actual booking success and approve the complete final patient confirmation and destination
inputs: actual saved appointment and patient record version
checked patient appointment fields
outputs: approved final actual appointment confirmation and patient destination

steps.what: Send the approved final appointment confirmation to the approved patient destination
inputs: approved final actual appointment confirmation and patient destination

steps.what: Write and approve actual reception details and remaining patient-record corrections
inputs: actual patient appointment request
actual saved appointment and patient record version
actual checked record discrepancies
outputs: approved final actual reception and record correction note

steps.what: Save the approved final reception and correction note
inputs: approved final actual reception and record correction note

tasks.design: Configure {PATIENT_SCHEDULER} native slot filters, exact appointment drafting and approved confirmation dispatch; OTHER denotes that scheduler and patient record. Keep reception, identity checks and patient choice human. Booking is committed before checking the actual confirmation; its complete final version is approved before separate external send. Both same-system saves earn no benefit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Slot searches, repeated patient fields and real confirmation dispatch may remain manual.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scheduling can filter exact constraints and reuse checked patient fields.
tasks.still_hard: Identity, suitability constraints and resolving a patients actual needs.
tasks.human_edge: The person handles uncertainty and obtains a clear patient choice.
tasks.altitude: Human patient reception with native appointment preparation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: patient schedulers can filter actual slots, reuse checked patient fields and dispatch an approved confirmation.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; measure residual search, repeated field entry and real recipient/attachment dispatch after current scheduler functions. Existing self-service, automatic confirmations and system runtime earn no new benefit.

Patient supplies actual identity, contact and request in s1; s2 retains full capture/checking of patient_id, contact_destination, service, authorised_duration and constraints. Clinician roster and service owner supply existing actual availability/rules. Missing authority or data uses manual scheduling.

s3 retains 7.5 hours for option checking; s5 counts actual patient choice and complete final review. s7 verifies real booking success and the actual final confirmation before send; failures return to manual resolution, not false confirmation.

The proposed 5 dispatch hours represent actual remaining manual confirmation preparation/routing actions, not a save click. s9 retains actual record correction capture and review. Same-system commits remain full; no clinical advice is generated.
research_questions: What search, field copying and real confirmation dispatch remain manual after current patient scheduling?

incremental.description: Maintain appointment constraint mappings and audit confirmations

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete final appointment and patient record changes
s7 actual complete final confirmation and patient destination after booking
s9 actual final reception and correction note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 7.5 slot-search, 15 repeated-field and 5 real confirmation-dispatch hours less 1.5 upkeep = 26. Low halves only repeated-field benefit: 7.5 minus 1.5 = 6. Saves earn none.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer case-progress inquiries within confidentiality limits.

steps.what: Receive the actual inquiry and verify requester identity, authority and permitted disclosure scope
inputs: actual requester and case-progress question
existing patient authorisation and disclosure policy
outputs: checked actual inquiry and permitted response scope

steps.what: Retrieve actual authorised case status using the native patient case-progress view
inputs: checked actual inquiry and permitted response scope
actual existing case status and source timestamps

steps.what: Write and approve the complete factual response and exact authorised recipient
inputs: checked permitted actual case-progress facts
checked actual inquiry and permitted response scope
outputs: approved final case-progress response and authorised recipient

steps.what: Deliver the approved final case-progress response to the authorised requester
inputs: approved final case-progress response and authorised recipient

steps.what: Write and approve the actual inquiry, authority check and disclosed information record
inputs: actual delivered case-progress response
checked actual inquiry and permitted response scope

steps.what: Save the approved final inquiry and disclosure note
inputs: approved final actual inquiry/disclosure note

tasks.design: Configure the native {CLINICAL_CASE_RECORD} permitted-status view, denoted OTHER. Retain identity/authority checking, factual response judgement and actual delivery with the person. The complete final response is approved before its separate external delivery. Actual disclosure note follows delivery; same-system save earns no benefit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Permitted actual case status may require navigation through several record screens.
tasks.enabler_now: A native case view can bring authorised status fields together without creating clinical advice.
tasks.still_hard: Confidentiality, ambiguous authority and knowing when a clinician must respond.
tasks.human_edge: The person respects the patients disclosure choices and communicates uncertainty clearly.
tasks.altitude: Human confidential case-progress responses with native fact retrieval.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native patient case views can expose existing authorised status fields with source timestamps.

assumptions: All shares are provisional; confirm residual status navigation after existing case views. No privacy check or clinical judgement is removed.

Normal clinical/administrative records supply actual case_id, current_stage, last_update and source_author; the patient/organisation supplies existing disclosure permissions. s1 retains actual identity/authority checks, s2 retains source freshness and scope checks. Missing or unclear information requires actual clinician clarification, not inference.

s3 retains full writing/checking of the complete permitted response. Clinical interpretation is referred under existing procedures. s5 captures actual request, authority_basis and disclosed_fact after delivery at full time. Any changed response returns to approval; same-system save stays full.
unknowns: Actual disclosure permissions and retrieval effort
research_questions: Which authorised case-progress facts still require repeated screen navigation?

incremental.description: Maintain permitted-status view and source labels

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final factual case response and exact authorised requester

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only status retrieval changes: 20 times 50% = 10 hours less 0.5 upkeep = 9.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 5 minus 0.5 = 4.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Human patient contact and confidentiality decisions with exact native scheduling/retrieval.
reach: Less repeated directory lookup, appointment copying and permitted-status retrieval
skills_to_grow: Checking appointment constraints and actual confirmation versions
role.ambitious_version: Patient-facing staff retain reception and disclosure judgement while native systems reduce genuinely repeated exact preparation.
